title: bluehour-dialpad-ashwin-2026-11-28
content:
BlueHour Dialpad — quick scratchpad (today)
Owner: Ashwin Patel — AE
Goals for today:
- 40 dials (target) / 25 connected / 6 booked meetings
- Clear 3 hot follow-ups from CRM (>= 7d stale)
- Run Subject Line A/B on cold email batch (100)

Warmups (09:00–09:30)
- Coffee + review notes for top 10 accounts flagged yesterday. Focus: pricing objection prep, new case study link.
- Sync w/ Maya quick check: confirm demo slot availability for CorporaCo at 14:00 PT.

Priority queue (start with these — high likelihood meetings):
1) CorporaCo — Champion: Jenna Morales (VP Ops) — CRM: 34567 — Last: 11/20 email — Note: pricing pushback; send tailored TCO slide. 
   Quick script: "Jenna, Ashwin from Redwood — saw your note on costs; quick 10-min breakdown of how we get to X tokens per user?" 
   Action: Call -> if VM leave: "Jenna, Ashwin at Redwood, quick follow-up re: TCO doc I sent — 415-555-0123 — will ping email."
2) Finlytix — Champion: Omar Rahman — CRM: 34911 — Gate: legal procurement underway — Need: SOC2+data residency notes. 
   Action: Email + call after 11:30; attach compliance one-pager.
3) StratusEd — Champion: Priya Nair — interested in Dedicated trial — demo scheduled 12/03; confirm scope.

Cold batch (11:00–12:30): 30 targets — use Subject A version 01 (short, benefit-led) and track open rate. Notes: try adding one line referencing recent press (if any).

Voicemail scripts (short):
- VM1: "Hi [Name], Ashwin from Redwood Inference. Quick note: I sent a one-pager on reducing inference costs — can I get 10 minutes to show examples? Call me 415-555-0123."
- VM2: "Hey [Name], Ashwin — curious if you're seeing latency spikes at peak? We helped X reduce p95 by 30%. Email follow-up incoming."

Follow-ups (by CRM filter: "needs follow-up")
- ACME Retail: replied "Maybe Q1" — Try: send ROI calc + propose quick check-in week of 12/08.
- NovaHealth: demo done 11/10, waiting on SOW sign-off — Need: escalate to solutions-engineering for updated quote. Linked: Jira:SALESEQ-412.

Notes to self / experiments:
- A/B subject lines: A) "Cut inference spend by 25% w/ one change" B) "How much does inference cost at peak for you?" Track opens + replies; aim N>=100 per variant.
- Quick KPI to monitor: connect rate, meetings booked / dial, and reply rate on A/B. Capture in sheet later.
- Try gating first cold call with a 2-line value prop only — reduce pitch to 30 seconds. See impact on connect->book conversion.

Loose checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Send TCO slide to Jenna
- [ ] Attach SOC2 one-pager to Finlytix email
- [ ] Confirm demo slot with Prod for StratusEd
- [ ] Load cold batch CSV into outreach tool
- [ ] Log all calls in CRM before EOD

Evening wrap (EOD notes):
- Quick wins: flagged 2 accounts for escalation; booked 1 meeting (CorporaCo tentative).
- Stalls: legal procurement timeline for Finlytix unclear — follow-up Friday.
- Learnings: short voicemail that mentions a numeric outcome ("reduce p95 by 30%") seems to get more call-backs in this cohort.

Fragments / one-liners to drop into messages:
- "We helped a fintech reduce inference spend per user by ~28% in 6 weeks."
- "Can we do a 10-min cost sanity check?"

Random TODOs (non-blocking):
- Update personal outreach template library with new TCO bullets.
- Ask Rafael for the new compliance slide deck.

Bottom-line: focus on high-probability accounts first, keep cold batch short & trackable, and close out CRM notes before leaving.

(Copy of quick link to storyboard: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/34567 )
